By his wounds, we were healed.

EVERY WOMAN MUST MAKE A FOOL OF HERSELF OVER A MAN...ONCE!

33909: Malabar Rebellion of 1921 and the anti-colonial uprising led by resistance leader Variyamkunnath Kunjahammed Haji.

Not every road leads you home

To find their future, they had to escape their past...
35701: Bishan loses his fortune while helping his friend Kishan in his singing career. Now successful, will Kishan return the favour?

Six ordinary individuals. Six extraordinary stories.

A Ritz is afraid of nothing ... but ... THIS ... IS ... SOMETHING!

Edward Elric / Van Hohenheim (Slave No.23) / Young "Father"

Past And Present Meets In This Land Of Turmoil!

The man who changed the game.

There is no place to hide

They Boldly Go Where No Woman Has Dared Go Before!

When the moon is full, the blood tide rises.

Meet the women who dared to reach for the stars.

Possessed with sex, they know no shame!
45685: A young Mexican boy tirelessly tries to save his pet bull from death at the hands of a celebrated matador.

Our story is about the geologists prospecting gold in the Extreme North.

Everybody's 'choice' for a great big wonderful time!

3,000 voltz couldn't kill him... It just gave him a buzz.

Experience a Lesson in Real Bad Taste; Expect the Worst
Karl the Butcher / K. The Butcher Shitter
47221: Scotland Yard investigates a series of murders where the victims have died by snake venom poisoning.
47733: When the matriarch of a family of assassins falls ill, her three children and younger boyfriend fight among themselves to take over her empire.
The family that kills together dies together

When your best option is a bad choice.

A giant monster greater than Godzilla or Rodan!

Strike up the band! Here comes The Greatest Musical Show on Earth!

And can Deepika escape Sukumar’s grip before everything collapses?

Never gamble when you are desperate...
